settings.bundleText: A bundle goes on the document as one line when all its components have the same VAT rate. Otherwise each component is in its own rate. A gift in a bundle takes its form from this setting, unless its place in the bundle says otherwise.
settings.fieldHelp: How a gift looks on an invoice or receipt. Example: an order for 203.98 PLN with a mug as the gift.

bundles.text: One line when all components share a VAT rate. When the rates differ, each component is in its own rate.
bundles.title: Bundles

forms.formText: Priced in proportionally: part of the payment goes to the gift. 0.01 from the most expensive line: the sum does not change. Shown at 0.00: only when the provider accepts a zero line. Left off: the gift is not on the document, ask your accountant. Own price: the gift at your price, taken from the most expensive line.
forms.sumText: With every form the document total equals what the customer paid. Only the split between lines changes.
forms.title: Five forms

precedence.text: The first setting OpenLinker finds wins: the form on the gift itself, then the channel's form, then this setting. For each gift you see where its form came from.

providers.text: Not every provider accepts a zero line. When the chosen provider does not, "Shown at 0.00" is unavailable for it and you see why.

since.text: The new form applies to documents issued after you save. OpenLinker never changes an issued document.
since.title: Since when

settings.guideButton: How a gift gets on the document

settings.precedenceHelp: The most specific setting wins. This default applies only when nothing above it set a form.

settings.refusingOne: {provider} does not accept it, so "Shown at 0.00" is unavailable in channels that issue {documents} through it.

settings.sectionLead: The default form for all of OpenLinker.
